title: Content Publish Review
description: Quality checklist before publishing a post or page — proofreading, links, images, SEO, and mobile preview.

steps.title: Proofread Copy & Headings
steps.instructions: Check spelling, grammar, and tone. Confirm one clear H1 and logical heading hierarchy (H2, H3).

steps.title: Test All Links
steps.instructions: Click every internal and external link. Open external links in a new tab only when appropriate; fix broken URLs.

steps.title: Review Images & Alt Text
steps.instructions: Compress large images if needed. Add descriptive alt text for informative images; leave decorative images with empty alt.

steps.title: Set Featured Image & Excerpt
steps.instructions: Choose a featured image that crops well in archives and social shares. Write a concise excerpt if the theme uses it.

steps.title: Set SEO Title & Description
steps.instructions: Customize the meta title and description in your SEO plugin. Preview how the URL will appear in search results.

steps.title: Assign Categories & Tags
steps.instructions: Pick the primary category and relevant tags. Avoid creating duplicate or overly granular categories.

steps.title: Preview on Mobile
steps.instructions: Use responsive preview or a phone to check line breaks, button sizes, and table overflow on small screens.
